'''Guardian''' was a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] used in the [[New Jedi Order]] by [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. At either end were wide emitter shrouds, giving the hilt the appearance of a two-bladed dagger when inactive.
